title: No alcohol
quote: ASUC funds shall not be used to purchase alcoholic beverages, or to reimburse the purchase of alcoholic beverages, under any circumstances.

title: Required fields
quote: Every request for funds must state the amount, the business purpose, and the budget line to be charged.

title: Banned categories
quote: ASUC funds may not be used for gift cards, cash or cash equivalents, donations to individuals, or items for personal use.
